SELECT id, job_name , job_group , invoke_target , job_message , status, elapsed_time , create_time FROM log_job
AND job_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.jobName}, '%')
AND job_group LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.jobGroup}, '%')
AND invoke_target LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.invokeTarget}, '%')
AND status = #{query.status}
AND elapsed_time = #{query.elapsedTime}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
